mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_student_binding ( teacher_id, teacher_name, student_id, student_name, college_name, course_code, course_name, course_class_code, academic_year, semester, source_type, sync_time ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{collegeName}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{courseClassCode}, COALESCE(#{academicYear}, ''), COALESCE(#{semester}, ''), #{sourceType}, #{syncTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE teacher_name = COALESCE(#{teacherName}, teacher_name), student_name = COALESCE(#{studentName}, student_name), college_name = COALESCE(#{collegeName}, college_name), course_name = COALESCE(#{courseName}, course_name), course_class_code = COALESCE(#{courseClassCode}, course_class_code), source_type = #{sourceType}, sync_time = #{syncTime}
